# Contributing

Contributions are limited to authorised members of the QuenchForge
organisation.

## Workflow

1. Branch from `main`: `feat/<topic>` or `fix/<topic>`.
2. Commit using [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/).
3. Open a pull request. A review from a code owner is required.

## Rules

- `manage.py` stays standard-library only.
- No secrets in code, commits, or issues.
